acquisition_decision_package.licensing_considerations: Commercial proprietary quantitative research license required; zero external redistribution
acquisition_decision_package.why_existing_free_data_is_insufficient:
1. Public endpoints (Yahoo Finance) exhibit hard retention limitations (7 days for 1m, 60 days for 5m).
2. Retail broker APIs prune expired options contracts immediately upon expiry and provide only OHLCV bars, never historical Bid/Ask quotes.
acquisition_decision_package.validation_criteria_upon_acquisition: All incoming datasets must pass the formal 11-stage DataOnboardingValidator with >= 250 sessions (intraday) and >= 70% paired quote coverage (options Level 3).
